description: Schema for parsed NOAA ISD core weather fields after Layer 2 parsing.

fields.name: wind_direction_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in degrees (0–360). Null if missing or invalid.

fields.name: wind_direction_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for wind direction.

fields.name: wind_speed_ms
fields.description: Wind speed in meters per second. Converted from tenths of m/s.

fields.name: wind_speed_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for wind speed.

fields.name: temperature_c
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Celsius. Converted from tenths.

fields.name: dew_point_c
fields.description: Dew point temperature in degrees Celsius. Converted from tenths.

fields.name: dew_point_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for dew point.

fields.name: sea_level_pressure_hpa
fields.description: Sea level pressure in hPa. Converted from tenths.

fields.name: sea_level_pressure_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for sea level pressure.

fields.name: visibility_distance_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for visibility distance.

fields.name: visibility_variability_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for visibility variability.

fields.name: ceiling_height_qc
fields.description: Quality control flag for ceiling height.
